items.title: India Secures First Asian Table Tennis Mixed Doubles Medal in 72 Years
items.summary: India achieved a historic feat by winning its first mixed doubles medal at the Asian Table Tennis Championship in 72 years. The Indian duo won the deciding game to secure the landmark victory.

items.title: Pankaj Advani Wins 29th World Title at World Billiards Championship
items.summary: Cue sports icon Pankaj Advani won his 29th world title at the World Billiards Championship. The 41-year-old was the only Indian player to reach the last-four stage before claiming the title.

items.title: Assam Government to Present 1st Bhupen Hazarika National Award to Usha Mangeshkar
items.summary: The Assam government announced that singer Usha Mangeshkar will be presented with the 1st Bhupen Hazarika National Award. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will present the award at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on November 29.

items.title: Madhya Pradesh Receives Over ₹15,400 Crore Investment Proposals at Semiconductor Summit
items.summary: Madhya Pradesh received investment proposals of over ₹15,400 crore at a semiconductor summit. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav stated that additional proposals worth around ₹5,800 crore have the potential to create 10,000 employment opportunities.

items.title: Bihar Attracts ₹1.21 Lakh Crore Investment Proposals Under Manufacturing Scheme
items.summary: Bihar has secured 1,091 investment proposals worth ₹1.21 lakh crore over the past 18 months. The state is actively implementing a national initiative to develop integrated manufacturing cities across 14 locations in India.

items.title: ITBP Overhauls Strategy Along China Border
items.summary: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) is revamping its training and combat deployment along the border with China. The paramilitary force was originally raised on October 24, 1962, following the Indo-China war.

items.title: Odisha Moves Supreme Court Over Kotia Border Dispute With Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Odisha has approached the Supreme Court against Andhra Pradesh regarding local election notifications in the disputed Kotia Gram Panchayat. Andhra Pradesh claims rights over 21 of the 28 villages in the area, where the apex court ordered status quo in 2006.

items.title: India and Azerbaijan Attempt Reset of Bilateral Relations
items.summary: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar met with the President and Foreign Minister of Azerbaijan to reset bilateral ties following previous strain. Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Bayramov highlighted trade, tourism, and energy cooperation after fruitful discussions.

items.title: IAEA Report Projects Global Nuclear Power Could More Than Triple by 2060
items.summary: According to the IAEA's annual report, global nuclear power capacity could more than triple by 2060. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi stated that this growth will be driven by electrification, AI-powered data centres, and technology companies seeking reliable, carbon-free power.

items.title: French and British Air Forces Stage Joint Nuclear Strike Simulation Exercise 'Rummy'
items.summary: The French and British air forces conducted their first joint nuclear strike simulation, codenamed 'Rummy', over the Mediterranean Sea. The exercise featured RAF Typhoon fighter jets operating alongside French Rafale aircraft.

items.title: UN Loss and Damage Fund Secures $822.06 Million in Pledges for Vulnerable Nations
items.summary: The UN Loss and Damage Fund recorded pledges totaling $822.06 million from 27 countries, with $629.70 million in grant contributions, providing crucial financial assistance to countries like Nepal.

items.title: Nepal to Receive First-Ever UN Loss and Damage Fund Payout
items.summary: Nepal is set to receive $21.6 million from the United Nations' Loss and Damage Fund following devastating Bhotekoshi floods. This marks the first time the global climate fund has earmarked money for a specific country to cover climate-change-linked losses.

items.title: Government Modifies Periodic Labour Force Survey to Include Gig Economy
items.summary: The Periodic Labour Force Survey will be modified with additional questions to capture data on the gig economy and unpaid household workers. The step aims to measure labour underutilisation across the nation.

items.title: Mona Agarwal and Nishad Kumar Named India's Closing Flag-Bearers at Asian Para Games
items.summary: Mona Agarwal and Nishad Kumar have been named India's flag-bearers for the closing ceremony of the Asian Para Games. Both athletes secured two gold medals each during the event.

items.title: Thulasimathi Murugesan Wins Gold in Badminton at Asian Para Games
items.summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan combined with Manasi Joshi to win the gold medal in women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton at the Asian Para Games. She finished the day with three medals, having also won two silver medals earlier.

items.title: Physicist Ashoke Sen Receives 2026 Oskar Klein Medal
items.summary: Ashoke Sen has been named the recipient of the 2026 Oskar Klein Medal.

items.title: Bharat Biotech Slashes Malaria Vaccine Price in Pact with UNICEF and GAVI
items.summary: Bharat Biotech has reduced the price of its malaria vaccine under a GAVI-backed agreement with UNICEF.

items.title: PM Modi to Inaugurate RBI Data Centre in Odisha
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate an RBI Data Centre in Odisha.

items.title: Ashoke Sen Becomes First Indian Physicist to Receive Oskar Klein Medal
items.summary: Ashoke Sen has become the first Indian physicist to be awarded the Oskar Klein Medal. He is internationally recognised for his work on S-duality, black hole entropy, and string field theory.

items.title: Prime Minister Lauds India's Record 114 Medals at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed happiness over India's best-ever performance at the Asian Para Games 2026, where the country won a record total of 114 medals.

items.title: Pankaj Advani Wins 29th World Title
items.summary: Indian player Pankaj Advani has secured his 29th world title.

items.title: Nihal Sarin and Koneru Humpy Win Gold at European Chess Club Cup
items.summary: Nihal Sarin and Koneru Humpy have won gold medals at the European Chess Club Cup.

items.title: India Targets 30 Million Tonnes of Fish Production in Five Years
items.summary: India has set a target to produce 30 million tonnes of fish over a five-year period.

items.title: Amur Falcons Complete 20,000-km Migration to Manipur
items.summary: Amur falcons have completed their 20,000-km long annual migratory route to Manipur.

items.title: Mysuru Dasara Drone Show Achieves Guinness World Record
items.summary: The drone show organised during the Mysuru Dasara festival set a new Guinness World Record.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh Ranks First in Mission Karmayogi Implementation
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh has emerged as the top-performing state in the implementation of Mission Karmayogi.

items.title: Lionel Messi Wins 2026 Princess of Asturias Sports Award
items.summary: Footballer Lionel Messi has been named the recipient of the 2026 Princess of Asturias Sports Award.

items.title: Sumit Antil Retains Asian Para Games Javelin F64 Title
items.summary: Para-athlete Sumit Antil successfully defended his javelin throw F64 title at the Asian Para Games.

items.title: Usha Mangeshkar Selected as Inaugural Recipient of Bhupen Hazarika Award
items.summary: Assam has named singer Usha Mangeshkar as the first recipient of the Bhupen Hazarika Award.

items.title: Bodhana Sivanandan Becomes Youngest Female International Master
items.summary: Bodhana Sivanandan has achieved the milestone of becoming the youngest female International Master in chess history.

items.title: India and Russia Target $100 Billion Bilateral Trade by 2030
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin directed officials to expand bilateral cooperation with a goal to reach $100 billion in trade by 2030. The discussion took place on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in New Delhi.

items.title: C-DOT Establishes Sixth Centre of Excellence at IIT (BHU)
items.summary: C-DOT has opened its sixth Centre of Excellence at IIT (BHU).

items.title: Centre Begins Nationwide Civil Defence Network Pilot
items.summary: The Centre has initiated a nationwide pilot for the Civil Defence Network.

items.title: Government Proposes PLFS Methodology Changes from January 2027
items.summary: The Government has proposed modifications to the PLFS methodology beginning in January 2027.

items.title: Maharashtra Launches Mission Murghas to Tackle Fodder Shortages
items.summary: Maharashtra has launched Mission Murghas to address fodder shortages in the state.

items.title: Tamil Nadu Adds Madras Hedgehog to Conservation Programme
items.summary: Tamil Nadu has included the Madras Hedgehog in its state conservation programme.

items.title: India to Build Secure Military AI Layer
items.summary: India plans to construct a secure military Artificial Intelligence layer.

items.title: ICC Sets Cricket Qualification Framework for LA28 Olympics
items.summary: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has announced the cricket qualification framework for the LA28 Olympics.

items.title: Government Proposes Merchant Discount Rate on High-Value UPI Transactions
items.summary: A government proposal seeks to introduce a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) of 0.25–0.5% on Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions exceeding ₹2,000. The move alters a decade-long policy to balance digital payment incentives for banks and fintechs with financial inclusion goals.

items.title: Ahmedabad to Host 2029 Senior Weightlifting World Championships
items.summary: Ahmedabad will host the senior Weightlifting World Championships in 2029, as announced by the International Weightlifting Federation (IWF). This will mark the first time the senior edition of the tournament is held in India.

items.title: Ladakh Becomes India’s First Fully Organic Union Territory
items.summary: Ladakh has officially become India's first fully organic Union Territory.

items.title: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla Meets Counterparts Ahead of BRICS Parliamentary Forum Meeting
items.summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla met his counterparts from Cuba and Russia prior to the BRICS parliamentary forum meeting. The meeting reviewed bilateral parliamentary exchanges between India and Russia as both nations mark the 80th anniversary of their ties.

items.title: Deep Depression Intensifies into Cyclonic Storm Arnab
items.summary: According to the IMD bulletin, a deep depression has intensified into Cyclonic Storm 'Arnab' over the Bay of Bengal. It is expected to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a severe cyclonic storm.

items.title: String Theory Pioneer Ashoke Sen Awarded Oskar Klein Medal
items.summary: Theoretical physicist Ashoke Sen has been awarded the Oskar Klein Medal. The award is presented by Stockholm University along with the Nobel Committee for Physics of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.

items.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Scope of Police Custody Under BNSS
items.summary: The Supreme Court has held that Section 187(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) enlarges the window during which police custody may be sought.

items.title: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva Wins Presidential Election in Brazil
items.summary: Former two-time President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated incumbent Jair Bolsonaro in the presidential elections in Brazil. He has promised a new form of welfarism focused on ecological and infrastructure spending.

items.title: ISRO Plans Four Launch Pads by 2029 with New Spaceport Facility
items.summary: The ISRO chief announced that the space agency aims to operate four launch pads by 2029. The upcoming spaceport facility at Kulasekarapattinam will feature launch pads, integration buildings, rail-track systems, and telemetry and tracking systems.

items.title: PV Sindhu Finishes Runner-Up at French Open
items.summary: Indian badminton player PV Sindhu finished as the runner-up after losing to Olympic champion An Se Young in the final. The victory gave An Se Young her fourth French Open title and 11th crown of the season.

items.title: DAC Clears Defence Acquisitions Worth ₹2.12 Lakh Crore
items.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) has cleared defence acquisitions worth ₹2.12 lakh crore.

items.title: Harry Kane Wins 2026 Men’s Ballon d’Or
items.summary: Harry Kane has won the 2026 Men’s Ballon d’Or award.

items.title: Maharashtra Approves Two Wildlife Sanctuaries and 14 Conservation Reserves
items.summary: Maharashtra has approved the establishment of two wildlife sanctuaries and 14 conservation reserves.

items.title: Amendments Announced for E100 Motor Vehicle Emission Rules
items.summary: Amendments to E100 vehicle rules modify Rule 115 regarding motor vehicle emission standards and Rule 115E regarding emission testing provisions.

items.title: Justice Tapabrata Chakraborty Elevated as Telangana High Court Chief Justice
items.summary: Justice Tapabrata Chakraborty of the Calcutta High Court has been elevated as the Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court.

items.title: CEC Can Be Removed Only Like a Supreme Court Judge, ECI Tells Top Court
items.summary: The Election Commission of India informed the Supreme Court that the Chief Election Commissioner can only be removed in the same manner as a Supreme Court judge. The ECI asserted in an affidavit that any attempt to restrain the CEC's functioning is contrary to the 2023 Act.

items.title: Harry Kane and Putellas Win Ballon d'Or Awards
items.summary: Harry Kane won the men's Ballon d'Or award, becoming the first Englishman to win it in 25 years, while Putellas won the women's Ballon d'Or award.

items.title: Jalandhar Hosts Asian Champions Trophy Hockey Tournament
items.summary: Jalandhar is hosting its maiden international hockey tournament, the Asian Champions Trophy. India faces Bangladesh in the tournament opener.

items.title: Union Minister Piyush Goyal Holds Bilateral Trade Meetings in Netherlands
items.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal held high-level meetings in the Netherlands to strengthen bilateral trade and investment relations.

items.title: Cyclone 'Arnab' Intensifies into Very Severe Cyclonic Storm
items.summary: Cyclonic storm 'Arnab' has intensified into a very severe cyclonic storm moving west-northwestwards. The system is expected to cross the coast close to Yanam by the forenoon of October 28, 2026.

items.title: Indian Navy Launches Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel Srishti
items.summary: The Indian Navy has launched Srishti, a Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel.

items.title: India Invites Pakistan Minister for SCO Civilisational Dialogue in Delhi
items.summary: India has extended an invitation to a Pakistani minister for the inaugural Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue in Delhi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the event, which features representatives from over 25 countries at Purana Quila.

items.title: Report Ranks India Among Top Countries for Heatwave Exposure in Vulnerable Groups
items.summary: A global report places India among the top countries facing the highest heatwave exposure for infants and older adults. Globally, total heatwave exposure days declined from the 2024 record of 15.3 billion person-days for older adults and 2.3 billion person-days for infants.

items.title: Current climate pledges will cut emissions by just 6% by 2035, far off track: UN report
items.summary: The UNFCCC’s 2026 NDC Synthesis Report found that even full implementation, including conditional pledges, would cut emissions only 9% below 2019 levels by 2035

items.title: At SCO meet, Rajnath calls for dismantling the entire ecosystem of terrorism
items.summary: There is no place for those who finance, support, or provide safe havens to terrorists, says Defence Minister; India supports adoption of action plan for trade and economic cooperation among SCO members

items.title: Cyclone Arnab Begins Landfall Process Along Andhra Pradesh Coast
items.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) announced that the landfall process of Cyclone Arnab has commenced along the Andhra Pradesh coast. The storm's northern spiral band has moved inland, with the process expected to continue over three hours.

items.title: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm 'Arnab' Begins Landfall Near Narsapur
items.summary: Very severe cyclonic storm 'Arnab' has begun its landfall process near Narsapur, bringing heavy rainfall to Vizag. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) noted that the landfall process may extend over a long period before a tentative point is finalized.

items.title: BRICS Parliamentary Forum Issues Declaration on West Asian Hostilities
items.summary: The BRICS parliamentary forum expressed deep concern regarding hostilities in West Asia through a joint declaration. The forum advocated for a two-state solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict while asserting the Palestinian people's right to self-determination and sovereignty.

items.title: EAM S. Jaishankar to Attend G20 Foreign Ministers' and Quad Meetings in the U.S.
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar is set to travel to the United States for the G20 Foreign Ministers' meeting and Quad discussions. The meetings will focus on preparations for the upcoming Quad Leaders' Summit and G20 Summit.

items.title: India poised to refine for world as global capacity declines: Union Minister Hardeep Puri
items.summary: India's refining capacity is currently around 290 million tonnes per annum and is expected to expand further, he said

items.title: DPIIT Launches Sixth National Startup Awards
items.summary: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) has launched the sixth edition of the National Startup Awards.

items.title: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas 2026 Observance Set for November 1 to 15
items.summary: The observance of Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas 2026 has been scheduled from November 1 to 15.

items.title: India and Mexico Launch PTA Negotiations
items.summary: India and Mexico have officially launched negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA).

items.title: MoRTH Introduces FASTag Annual Local Pass
items.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) has introduced an annual local pass feature for FASTag.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh Approves PRAGATI AI and Robotics Park
items.summary: The state government of Uttar Pradesh has approved the establishment of the PRAGATI AI and Robotics Park.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh Put on High Alert Due to Cyclone Arnab Threat
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh has been placed on high alert with evacuation orders issued in response to the threat posed by Cyclone Arnab.

items.title: Cabinet Approves Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana with a financial outlay of ₹7,395 crore.

items.title: Cabinet Approves ₹10,000-Crore Shipping Container Manufacturing Programme
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a ₹10,000-crore manufacturing programme dedicated to shipping containers.

items.title: NPPA Revises Prices of 543 Anti-Cancer Medicine Brands
items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has revised the prices of 543 anti-cancer medicine brands.

items.title: India Offers Anti-Terror Expertise to ASEAN and Dialogue Partners
items.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh offered to share India's anti-terror expertise with ASEAN and stated India will remain a trusted net security provider in the Indian Ocean region and Indo-Pacific.

items.title: World Stroke Day Observed on October 29
items.summary: World Stroke Day is observed on October 29 to highlight awareness and emergency care for stroke patients. In Karnataka, a hub-and-spoke model is being utilised to extend specialised stroke care and reduce emergency transfers to Bengaluru.

items.title: India and Poland Aim to Raise Bilateral Trade to $10 Billion
items.summary: India and Poland are seeking to increase their bilateral trade from $6 billion to $10 billion following the elevation of their ties to a strategic partnership. The move comes after Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Poland in 2024 to strengthen bilateral relations.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves 3% Dearness Allowance Hike for Central Employees
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a 3% increase in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) effective from July 1, 2026. The decision will benefit 48.54 lakh central government employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners.

items.title: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva Secures Fourth Term as President of Brazil
items.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has secured an unprecedented fourth term as President of Brazil at the age of 81.

items.title: India and Mexico Sign Terms of Reference for Preferential Trade Agreement Negotiations
items.summary: India and Mexico have signed the Terms of Reference to begin negotiations for a preferential trade agreement. The agreement was signed during the visit of Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal to Mexico.

items.title: Abhishek Sharma Becomes World No. 1 T20I Batter
items.summary: Abhishek Sharma surpassed Ishan Kishan to become the world No. 1 batter in the T20I rankings. He achieved this after scoring his fourth T20I century, making 113 runs off 38 balls on October 27 to lead India to a six-wicket victory in the third T20I.

items.title: ESIC Extends Deadline for New Amnesty Scheme 2025 to December 31, 2026
items.summary: The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has extended the deadline for its New Amnesty Scheme 2025 to December 31, 2026. This extension gives employers and insured persons more time to settle pending cases.

items.title: Centre Increases DA and DR by 3%
items.summary: The Central Government has raised Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) by 3% effective from July 1.

items.title: Kajal Dhochak and Neelam Sirohi Win World Wrestling Silver
items.summary: Indian wrestlers Kajal Dhochak and Neelam Sirohi won silver medals at the World Wrestling event.

items.title: Textile PLI Scheme Reopens with ₹100 Crore Turnover Threshold
items.summary: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for the textile sector has been reopened with a turnover threshold of ₹100 crore.

items.title: Labour Ministry Constitutes National Social Security Boards for Workers
items.summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment has set up National Social Security Boards to design, monitor, and recommend welfare schemes for traditional unorganised, gig, and platform workers.

items.title: ISRO's NVS-03 Satellite Launch Aimed at Restoring NavIC Navigation System
items.summary: ISRO's NVS-03 mission aims to restore the functioning of NavIC, India's regional satellite navigation system. The development of NavIC began after GPS access was restricted to India following the 1999 Kargil War.

items.title: ISRO Prepares for GSLV-F18 Launch Carrying NVS-03 Navigation Satellite
items.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation is preparing to launch the GSLV-F18 rocket carrying the NVS-03 navigation satellite from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre. The lift-off is scheduled from the second launch pad at the spaceport.

items.title: India Votes in Favour of UNGA Resolution Calling for End to US Embargo on Cuba
items.summary: The 193-member General Assembly adopted a resolution on October 28 calling for an end to the United States embargo on Cuba. India voted in favour of the resolution, which was supported by 130 countries, while 17 voted against and 25 abstained.

items.title: Rashid Khan Becomes First Men's Cricketer to Take 200 T20I Wickets
items.summary: Afghanistan bowler Rashid Khan became the first men's player in cricket history to reach 200 wickets in T20 Internationals. He achieved the milestone in his 120th T20I match with an average of 13.96.

items.title: Manisha Bhanwala Reaches World Wrestling Championships Final
items.summary: Indian wrestler Manisha Bhanwala reached the final of the World Wrestling Championships after pinning Canadian bronze medallist Laurence Beauregard. She became the third Indian woman wrestler in history to reach the final of the tournament.

items.title: PM Inaugurates ₹325-Crore Bovine Breeding Centre in Gujarat
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a ₹325-crore bovine breeding centre in Banaskantha and launched the Bharat Parv 2026 festival at Ekta Nagar in Gujarat.

items.title: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Arnab Strikes Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Arnab, a very severe cyclonic storm, triggered the evacuation of over 55,000 people across nine districts in Odisha and caused an estimated loss of ₹4,600 crore in Andhra Pradesh.

items.title: EAM Jaishankar Participates in G20 Foreign Ministers' Meet in United States
items.summary: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar visited the United States to participate in the two-day G20 Foreign Ministers' meeting. The deliberations focus on key geopolitical issues.

items.title: India Outlines AI and Maritime Security as Key Priorities for UNSC 2028–29 Term
items.summary: India announced artificial intelligence and maritime security as primary priorities for its UNSC candidature for 2028–29. Representative Parvathaneni highlighted the critical necessity of safeguarding freedom of navigation and commercial shipping chokepoints.

items.title: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 Provisions on Driving Age Restrictions
items.summary: Section 4 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 prohibits individuals under 18 years of age from driving motor vehicles in public places. However, it permits individuals who have attained 16 years of age to drive gearless motorcycles with an engine capacity not exceeding 50cc.

items.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde Announces Resignation Effective February 7
items.summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde has announced that she will resign from her position effective February 7.

items.title: India and U.K. Target $120 Billion Bilateral Trade by 2030
items.summary: India and the United Kingdom are aiming to double their bilateral trade to approximately $120 billion by the year 2030.

items.title: Supreme Court Directs RBI to Frame Measures Against Digital Arrest Fraud
items.summary: The Supreme Court has directed the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to frame regulatory measures to combat digital arrest fraud.

items.title: Bhutan Glacial Outburst Triggers Flood Alerts in Assam and West Bengal
items.summary: A Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) in Bhutan has led to flood alerts being issued across Assam and West Bengal.

items.title: NASA's Juno Spacecraft Detects Complex Plasma Waves at Jupiter
items.summary: The Juno spacecraft has detected complex plasma waves at Jupiter's bow shock region.

items.title: Anil Menon Completes Fourth Spacewalk at the ISS
items.summary: Astronaut Anil Menon has successfully completed his fourth spacewalk at the International Space Station.
